{{Quote|You have cleaned the guard? Oiled the action? Filed the symon tube? Checked the lower quartile? Adjusted the mesobanis timer?|Commander Kulkis, to Nightwing, in a story shared on the Cularin holonet node|<ref name="the best defense">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/livingforce/swlf20050310b|text=The Best Defense}}</ref>}}
A '''mesobanis timer''' was a [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]] component that was referenced in a short story by an anonymous individual that was circulated on the [[Cularin holonet node]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The story depicted the protagonist [[Nightwing]], an enlisted [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] in the [[Thaereian military]], experiencing a jam in his [[MX9]] blaster rifle; the superior [[Officer/Legends|officer]] [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Kulkis]] queried whether Nightwing had tried adjusting the mesobanis timer on the weapon.<ref name="the best defense" />
